covers: The actual UI/behavior of the hidden admin surfaces (/xloginy purchase dashboard, /xerrors error inbox, /xpricing package pricing, /xversion min-app-version + usage report, /xnotificationy broadcast + individual notifications, /xactivityy, /xpartnersy, /xsupport, /xeventsy event modals) — routing.json only documents that they exist and are unlisted; this covers what they render and how they authenticate.

shared_shell.component: AdminNav.tsx and AdminLoginCard.tsx provide the shared admin shell; the rail mark is public/app-logo.png (since 2026-11-08, f348) linked to '/'. See f051/f099.
shared_shell.layouts: src/app/xloginy/layout.tsx, src/app/xerrors/layout.tsx, and src/app/xpricing/layout.tsx all set indexable:false via createMetadata — belt-and-suspenders with the privateRoutePrefixes robots/sitemap exclusion in routing.json

auth_pattern.storage: Admin pages keep the dashboard token in a JS-readable cookie named 'velocity-admin-dashboard-token' (Path=/, SameSite=Strict, Secure on https, Max-Age = seconds until the token's exp), written by src/app/useAdminSession.ts via src/lib/adminTokenCookie.ts. It is NOT sessionStorage (corrected by f182 and f307; the earlier f044 claim is superseded). Because it is a cookie it survives new tabs and browser restarts until expiry, and every admin page on the origin shares it: logging in on one page signs in the others on the next load. Login/logout dispatch an 'admin-session-change' window event so the AdminNav sidebar's own hook instance follows along.
auth_pattern.risk: The cookie is not httpOnly, so it is readable with document.cookie: an XSS on any admin page can read the admin dashboard token directly, a materially different trust model from the httpOnly esim_at/esim_rt user-session cookies in topics/auth.json.
auth_pattern.duplication: RESOLVED (f052): all admin pages use the shared src/app/useAdminSession.ts hook + AdminLoginCard.tsx (xloginy, xerrors, xactivityy, xcryptoy, xmailx, xnotificationy, xpartnersy, xpricing, xstreaky, xsupport, xtestimonialsy, xtripplany, xtroubley, xversion, xeventsy), closing out what f045 originally flagged.
auth_pattern.backend_note: the token itself and its issuance are backend concepts (see E-SIM backend feedAI's admin.json topic) — this file only covers how the Next.js pages consume it.

xloginy_purchase_dashboard.data_source: GET /bff/admin/dashboard (Bearer token) -> {summary:{purchaseCount,userCount,revenueByCurrency,latestPurchaseAt}, chart:[{date,purchases,revenueCents}], purchases:Purchase[], users:DashboardUser[], recentOtpRequests:OtpRequestEvent[]}
xloginy_purchase_dashboard.renders: 4 summary stat cards (total purchases/revenue/latest purchase/total users), a hand-rolled inline SVG bar chart component (PurchasesChart, no charting library) for purchases-over-time, and 3 tables: Purchases (email/package/price/status/date), Users (email/created/updated/otpRequestCount/lastOtpRequestedAt), Recent OTP requests (email/status/timestamp/error).
xloginy_purchase_dashboard.pagination: f088 (2026-09-02): each of the 3 tables got its own page/pageSize selector + prev/next controls, matching the backend's now-paginated GET /api/admin/dashboard (E-SIM backend f118). bff/admin/dashboard/route.ts forwards the pagination query params through unchanged; summary stats still reflect ALL rows, not just the current page.
xloginy_purchase_dashboard.formatting: formatMoney uses Intl.NumberFormat with the purchase's own currency (paymentCurrency), amountCents/100; formatDate uses Intl.DateTimeFormat medium/short.

xerrors_error_inbox.file: src/app/xerrors/page.tsx (+ ErrorFiltersPanel.tsx, ErrorDetailPanel.tsx; helpers src/lib/xerrors-filters.ts, xerrors-report.ts)
xerrors_error_inbox.data_source: GET /bff/admin/errors (server-side filters in the URL, cursor pagination -> {errors,nextCursor,total}); GET /bff/admin/errors/stats (stat cards); GET /bff/admin/errors/:id (token, apiCalls, stack, clientContext); PATCH /:id; POST /:id/repair. See f310, f311, f315.
xerrors_error_inbox.layout: master-detail: a filterable table on the left (time/severity/area/email/method+path/status/message/state), clicking a row selects it and shows full detail in a right-hand aside (request id, user, API path, provider info, related payment/package/ICCID, repair action, safe request body/query as pretty-printed JSON).
xerrors_error_inbox.safe_curl_reconstruction: RESOLVED (f309): buildBackendCurl targets `${siteUrl}/api` with the stored token and client headers; Copy full report builds markdown.
xerrors_error_inbox.actions: Copy request id, Copy safe cURL (clipboard), Save admin notes, Mark resolved, and (only when the error has a repairAction) Run repair — a one-click trigger of the backend's idempotent provisioning retry (see E-SIM backend feedAI's admin.json 'repair_actions').
xerrors_error_inbox.note: f171/f174: list uses realFailuresOnly; Copy email + replay cURL with authorizationHeader; displayBackendResponse reconstructs from message when backendResponse is null; no severity info/warning filter.

xpricing_price_management.data_source: GET /bff/admin/packages/pricing -> {packages:[{packageId,title,country,countryCode,flagUrl,type,network,dataLabel,durationDays,originalPrice,retailPrice,discountEnabled,discountLabel,trending,discountType,discountValue,discountDirection,finalPrice}]} (countryCode/flagUrl/network/dataLabel/durationDays added 2026-08-24, f055; discountDirection added 2026-08-24, f061); PUT /bff/admin/packages/pricing/:packageId saves one row including the admin-controlled trending boolean; POST /bff/admin/packages/pricing/bulk-discount applies an adjustment to many rows at once without touching retailPrice/sell price.
xpricing_price_management.renders: 3 summary stat cards (total packages/with discount/selected), a bulk-discount panel (enable toggle, direction decrease|increase (f061), percentage|flat, value, 'Apply to selected (N)' / 'Apply to ALL packages'), a bulk-profit panel (f164: direction/type/value, applies to selected|all by adjusting each row's profit then PUT retailPrice = buy+profit), a 'Reset to default' panel (added 2026-08-24, f059: 'Reset selected (N)' / 'Reset ALL to default' buttons, POST /bff/admin/packages/pricing/reset {packageIds:'all'|string[]}), and a searchable, checkbox-selectable table: Coverage (flag+country), Type (icon), Network, Package (dataLabel), Validity (durationDays), Buy price (read-only originalPrice), Pok (fixed POK_FEE 0.25 EUR, f163), Sell price (read-only buy+profit, f164), Profit (editable draft.profit, f164), and Adjustment (discount/markup fields with a decrease/increase direction selector), plus a row filter dropdown ('All rows', 'Adjust on', 'Trending on', 'Discount label on') that combines with search and evaluates the current row drafts so unsaved toggles immediately change visibility (f151), a client-computed finalPrice preview under the 'Price' header (previewFinalPrice(), mirrors the backend's computeFinalPrice formula so the row updates live before Save), and a per-row action cell with Save plus a Reset button (calls the same reset endpoint scoped to just that packageId).
xpricing_price_management.reset_to_default: resetPricing(packageIds) takes an explicit id array/'all' so per-row Reset avoids stale selection state. Reset deletes the backend PackagePricing override, restoring the live default for display and checkout.
xpricing_price_management.auth: uses src/app/useAdminSession.ts (see auth_pattern.duplication) rather than its own copy of the login logic.
xpricing_price_management.trending: The per-row Trending checkbox is persisted through the existing PUT payload and controls the mobile Marketplace rail; it is not a separate BFF route.
